foreach(_puredarwin_xpc_dir
    libnv
    libinfo
    libxpc
    launchd
    notify
    logd
)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${_puredarwin_xpc_dir}/CMakeLists.txt")
        add_subdirectory("${_puredarwin_xpc_dir}")
    endif()
endforeach()

# libxpc's liblaunch/libvproc/libbootstrap #include "job.h" etc, generated by
# launchd/'s mig() calls - wire that up here, after both subdirs exist, to
# avoid the configure-time target-existence ordering constraints mig() has.
if(TARGET XPC_libxpc_static AND TARGET XPC_launchd_mig_static)
    target_include_directories(XPC_libxpc_static PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/launchd)
    add_dependencies(XPC_libxpc_static XPC_launchd_mig_static)
endif()
